name: Häagen-Dazs Vanilla Swiss Almond Ice Cream (WARNING)
whyItWorks: A double flare hazard: 18g of heavy butterfat per 1/2 cup triggers rapid gastrocolic emptying and biliary diarrhea, while whole roasted almonds break into rigid, sharp jagged nuts that risk bowel impaction.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active disease. If craving Häagen-Dazs in remission, choose plain Vanilla without nuts or seeds.
